_comment: Steps GitHub runs on RestoreAssist PRs that cannot be reproduced on a laptop. Every entry says why. Adding one widens the gap between local green and GitHub green, so each needs a reason a reviewer can check.

exempt.reason: Audits the Vercel PREVIEW deployment of the PR; 'Determine target URL' resolves it with github.token from the deployment API. No preview exists before push.
Advisory multi-model review that posts a PR comment using the repo's OPENROUTER_API_KEY secret. It exits green when no seat is configured; its verdict is not a build or test outcome.

Downloads the Linux x64 gitleaks release and verifies it with GNU sha256sum; the binary cannot execute on macOS. KNOWN GAP: secrets in the working tree are only caught by GitHub for this repo until gitleaks is installed locally.
